belief_statement: Preliminary evidence indicates that architectural education year years does not reliably affect assessment attributes flatness material. The evidence base (5 findings, 3 studies) is growing but not yet conclusive.

latent_variables.name: Dose and duration
latent_variables.rationale: Most studies measure presence/absence of architectural education year years, not dose-response curves. Duration and intensity likely matter.
latent_variables.suggested_measure: Parametric variation of intensity and exposure duration

research_needs.question: Does the effect of architectural education year years on assessment attributes flatness material replicate in a pre-registered RCT?
research_needs.rationale: Current confidence is moderate. A well-powered pre-registered replication would most efficiently resolve the status of this belief.

research_needs.question: What is the dose-response curve for architectural education year years effects on assessment attributes flatness material?
research_needs.rationale: Dose-response data enables design guidelines with specific thresholds.
